text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I know, right? I ran with everything I had!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I really gave it my all, but... I didn't get
first.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I guess this means I'll never be a Triple
Crown
champion...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may not be able to claim the same
title that
Rudolf once did, but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
choice_data_list: シンボリルドルフを追い越すことはできる

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's right! My dream isn't over!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll train my heart out so I never lose ever
again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio is strong in both body and
soul.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Per her wishes, we continue training the
very next
day.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's get this training started! I
gotta give it
my all if I'm gonna win the
other Triple Crown
races!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And I know where to start—I wanna do
some more
of that partner running!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! You're being too easy on me,
Trainer!
choice_data_list: レースの疲労は大丈夫か？
レースの疲労は大丈夫？
choice_data_list_en: Are you holding up alright from the race fatigue?
Are you feeling okay from the race fatigue?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If there's one thing I learned from the
Satsuki
Sho, it's that these Classic races
are no joke!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And you know what race is next up,
don't you?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yep! The Derby is every runner's dream
race!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All my opponents are gonna be bringing
their
A-game, which means I gotta do
the same!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So I need to start running pronto!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without a moment to lose, Teio dashes
off to find
her next training partner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no time to rest. Our training for
the
Japanese Derby begins at once.
